title: Braided Cosmic Wanderer
description: A surreal black and white illustration features a giant central figure with a round head, three eyes including a flower in the forehead, and a wide toothy grin with tears. A long thick braid extends downward like a path, ending in a sneaker at the bottom. The figure stands amid a field of smiling flowers, with snow-capped mountains in the background that have faces on them. Swirling cosmic patterns, planets, stars, and geometric shapes fill the dark sky above.
prompt: Surreal black and white illustration with selective purple and teal accents on a dark background. A giant round-headed figure with three eyes, one a purple flower, two smaller flower eyes, and a wide grinning mouth with tears stands in the center. A very long thick braid runs down from its head like a path through a field of smiling purple and white flowers, ending in a white sneaker at the bottom. Snow-capped mountains with carved smiling and frowning faces in the background. Swirling galaxy patterns, floating planets with rings, stars, geometric shapes, and small floating heads fill the cosmic sky above.
medium: chalk or pastel on black paper
